_meta.notes: harvest months drive the ENSO seasonal alignment in build_enso_model.py: harvest Jan-Aug uses ONI DJF(Y), Sep-Dec uses DJF(Y+1)
_meta.source: USDA IPAD crop calendars (FAO/GIEWS + FAS/GMA), read from Wayback-archived images; IPAD is retired

The NSW/Victoria calendar (https://web.archive.org/web/20210321120510id_/https://ipad.fas.usda.gov/rssiws/al/crop_calendar/images/as_as_nsw_victoria_calendar.png) shows identical bar extents. wheat.note: USDA publishes Australia only as regional calendars; used Western Australia, the largest wheat state (~40-45% of national production). Other regions read for comparison: Southern Australia plants Apr-Jun and harvests Nov-Jan; NSW/Victoria plants Apr-Jun and harvests Dec-Jan; Queensland plants Apr-Jul and harvests Oct-Nov. All are in the Sep-Dec ONI bucket except the Jan tail.
